title: Mar bar Pupidata of Pumbedita
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Eruvin 60a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.60a.7), Rav Yosef sends Abaye to arrange an eruv for the people of Kakunai. Abaye recalls [the straw storehouse](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.60a.11) belonging to Mar bar Pupidata of Pumbedita that was used as the portion excluded from Pumbedita’s eruv. From this Hyman infers that he was a rabbinic scholar in Abaye’s time.

notes.text: Shiyur is the portion left outside the communal eruv. Hyman infers that the owner was a scholar in Abaye’s time. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2427&lang=en) cites the same storehouse and says that he does not know whether Mar was a scholar.
